# Skyline Appraisal

> Skyline Appraisal is a locally owned residential real estate appraisal company based in Weaverville, North Carolina, serving Asheville and Western North Carolina. Appraisals are performed by Jay Jungels, the owner and a state-certified appraiser with more than 20 years of experience.

## Service area

Asheville, Weaverville and surrounding Western North Carolina, including Buncombe, Haywood, Henderson, Madison, and Yancey County.

## Services

Residential real estate appraisals for:

- Mortgages and purchases
- Refinance
- FHA loans
- Home equity
- Vacant land
- Condominiums
- Relocation
- Insurance
- Income property
- Property tax appeal
